qa: You choose 1 of your Digimon for every 2 colors your Tamers have. The target Digimon aren't affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects until their turn ends.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.) [On Play] [When Digivolving] Until your opponent's turn ends, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, their Digimon's effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon. [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest DP Digimon.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
